# Organisation: what a company is

> What a company is, as an organisation: the functions it must perform (economic, legal, technical, human), the roles and structure that perform them, its description as an information-processing system, and how it adapts. Scope only; the first review is not started.

Each page's markdown source is served at the same path with a .md extension. This index is written by hand; AGENTS.md says to keep it in step.

## The repository

- [Organisation: what a company is](https://tewf.github.io/business-organisation/README.md): the scope, the first job and the questions
- [Decisions](https://tewf.github.io/business-organisation/decisions/README.md): one record per choice that shapes the repository

## Contributing

- [Contributing](https://tewf.github.io/business-organisation/AGENTS.md): rules for changing this repository
